title: feat(studio): rich landing/overview page for the Studio app root
body:
## Summary

Replaces the **blank Studio landing page** (`/apps/:appName/` root) with a rich, data-driven overview. Previously the app root resolved to an empty `<Navigate to="">` target and rendered a blank content area — the first thing users saw was nothing.

The new `StudioHomePage` is built entirely on existing hooks (`useMetadataTypes`, `useGlobalDiagnostics`, `useRecentItems`), so it stays correct regardless of which packages are installed.

### What it adds
- **Hero band** — time-of-day greeting, headline, and glass KPI pills (types / writable / packages) over a gradient + dot-grid backdrop.
- **KPI cards** — types, runtime-writable, packages, and a **health card** that deep-links to diagnostics (amber when issues exist, emerald "all healthy" otherwise).
- **Quick actions** — one-click "New …" chips for writable types (object, view, page, dashboard, report, flow, action, agent).
- **Explore grid** — one card per metadata domain, each listing its top types as count-badged chips that link straight into the list page.
- **Recently viewed** — pulls from the shared `RecentItemsProvider` with per-type icons and relative timestamps.
- Full **en-US / zh-CN** i18n via the `engine.home.*` keys.

### Routing change
`AppContent` index route now honours a configured landing target when one exists, and falls back to `StudioHomePage` when `resolveLandingRoute` returns empty (the metadata-admin "Studio" app has domain-based nav with no single landing). Data apps with a real landing route are unaffected.

## How it looks
Hero + KPIs + quick actions render with gradient accents and hover lift; verified live at `localhost:5180/apps/studio/` in both light layout and at desktop width.

## Reviewer notes
- This branch was cut from local `main`, which had **4 unpushed commits** at the time. An auto-commit hook interleaved this session's landing-page work with concurrent studio metadata work (client-side validators, 15 new spec-7.1 metadata types, SetupPage tweaks, locale additions). Those changes share files (notably `i18n.ts`) and could not be cleanly split out, so they ride along in this PR. Please review the non-landing-page commits (`feat(studio): wire 10 more client-side metadata validators`, `feat(studio): handle 15 new metadata types exposed by spec 7.1`) with that context.

## Test plan
- [x] Root `/apps/studio/` renders the overview (was blank)
- [x] No console errors on load
- [ ] Verify quick-action "New …" links land on the create form
- [ ] Verify domain chips navigate to the correct type list
- [ ] Verify dark mode
